title: Taylor secretly chief scientist of UAP Task Force

tellings.quote: unbeknownst to us, he gets called into meetings in Washington, D.C. and he's called in to be the chief scientist of the UAP Task Force.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of strange events, says that around 2020 a scientist on the ranch team, Travis Taylor, was quietly called into meetings in Washington, D.C. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that, without the rest of the team knowing, Taylor was made chief scientist of the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to look into UAP, the government's term for unidentified objects in the sky. That would mean someone studying the ranch was also at the centre of the government's own inquiry.
